Job Overview The Data Analyst is responsible for transforming program and organizational data into meaningful, accessible insights that support program quality, continuous improvement, evaluation, grant reporting, and organizational decision-making across the AVANCE Network. Working closely with the Director of Research and Evaluation, the Programs Team, the Data Coordinator, and other organizational partners, the Data Analyst analyzes participant, program, site, and network-level data; develops dashboards, reports, and visualizations; identifies trends and patterns; and translates findings into clear summaries for diverse audiences. This position also monitors data quality, ensuring that available data are accurate and reliable. The Data Analyst focuses primarily on analysis, interpretation, visualization, reporting, and decision support. The Data Analyst is responsible for creating a welcoming atmosphere for AVANCE internal employees, external program participants, chapters, partners, and stakeholders. Job Responsibilities Research, Evaluation, and Program Fidelity Analyze program implementation, fidelity, attendance, enrollment, retention, completion, participant outcomes, surveys, assessments, and other program data across the AVANCE Network. Support the Director of Research and Evaluation in the development and refinement of evaluation questions, measurement plans, data collection tools, outcome frameworks, and reporting approaches. Compile literature reviews in alignment with these tasks. Conduct routine and ad hoc analyses to assess program progress, trends, strengths, gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Support cross-program comparisons, cohort analysis, and longitudinal tracking where data are available and appropriate. Partner with the Programs Team to interpret data in ways that inform program quality, technical assistance, coaching, partner support, and continuous improvement. Contribute to grant applications and reports, Board reports, strategic investor updates, internal learning reports, and external presentations. Data Analysis, Visualization, and Reporting Develop dashboards, data visualizations, scorecards, and summary reports for leadership, program teams, chapters, partners, Board committees, and strategic investors. Create standardized reports that communicate key metrics, including enrollment, attendance, retention, completion, participant outcomes, assessment results, survey results and fidelity indicators. Translate complex data into clear narratives, presentations, and recommendations for audiences with varying levels of data expertise. Identify patterns, gaps, outliers, and data quality concerns in collaboration with the Data Coordinator, program staff, and site leaders. Maintain recurring reporting calendars and support timely completion of monthly, quarterly, annual, and grant-specific reporting deliverables. Support the development of data dictionaries, metric definitions, report templates, dashboard structures, and data visualization standards. Data Systems and Data Quality Partner with the Data Coordinator to validate, clean, prepare, and document data for analysis and reporting. Use centralized data systems, spreadsheets, survey platforms, and approved data tools to extract, combine, analyze, and report program data. Support improvements to data collection, storage, and reporting processes to strengthen usability, consistency, accuracy, and timeliness. Ensure analyses and reports are aligned to data governance, confidentiality, and applicable organizational policies and federal requirements. Document analytic methods, assumptions, definitions, limitations, and data sources so that reports are transparent and replicable. Interdepartmental Coordination Collaborate with Research and Evaluation, Programs, Grants, Development, Communications, Finance, IT, and other internal teams to ensure data products support organizational priorities and program decision-making. Facilitate data review conversations that help teams interpret findings, ask stronger questions, and identify next steps for improvement. Respond to approved data requests and prioritize analytical work in partnership with the Director of Research and Evaluation. Build data literacy across teams by supporting consistent understanding and use of key metrics, dashboards, and reports. Stakeholder Collaboration Prepare accessible data summaries for AVANCE leadership, chapter staff, partners, funders, Board committees, and other stakeholders. Support partner and chapter conversations by producing actionable analyses, not just data tables. Serve as a thought partner to program leaders on metrics, trends, outcomes, and improvement questions. Communicate findings in culturally responsive, strengths-based, and mission-aligned ways. Training and Professional Development Support training for dashboards, reports, data interpretation, and appropriate use of data products across the AVANCE Network. Facilitate virtual and in-person professional development sessions, incorporating tools such as Screencastify, Mentimeter, Canva, or other interactive technologies to engage with participants. Develop user guides, report guides, and other resources that help staff understand and use data accurately. Engage in continuous improvement of dashboards, reports, and data processes based on user feedback. Stay current on nonprofit program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis methods, and relevant technology tools. Role-Specific Competencies Analytical thinking and problem solving Data storytelling and visualization Continuous improvement orientation Collaboration and service orientation Project management and follow-through Confidentiality and ethical use of data Perform other duties as assigned that are consistent with the general scope and level of the position.

The Product Data Analyst I supports Rheem’s Product Management team by maintaining accurate, complete, and consistent product information across business systems and customer-facing channels. This role helps ensure product attributes, specifications, classifications, digital assets, and related records are governed throughout the product lifecycle, from product setup and launch through updates and end-of-life activities.
Working closely with Product Managers and cross-functional partners, the Product Data Analyst I analyzes product information, resolves data-quality issues, supports reporting, and improves the processes used to manage Rheem product data. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, comfortable working across multiple systems, and able to translate business requirements into reliable product information.
This position will support Rheem North America, and can be located in Fort Smith, Arkansas or Lewisville, Texas. This role follows our hybrid work arrangement, with team members working in the office Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays.

Maintain product master data, attributes, specifications, hierarchies, classifications, and related records in Product Information Management (PIM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Digital Asset Management (DAM), and associated systems.

Partner with Product Managers to support new product introductions, product changes, line extensions, substitutions, and product discontinuations by ensuring required data is complete and available on schedule.

Collect, organize, and prepare product data for internal teams, distributors, customers, websites, catalogs, digital tools, and other downstream channels.

Create and maintain reports, dashboards, audits, and exception files that help the Product team monitor product-data readiness and resolve gaps.

Support product taxonomy, metadata, data definitions, and documentation to improve how product information is structured, searched, reported, and reused.

Assist with bulk uploads, data migrations, system enhancements, testing, and validation related to product information and product-management processes.

Investigate and respond to product-data questions and access issues, escalating system or governance concerns when appropriate.

Document repeatable work processes and recommend practical improvements that increase data accuracy, efficiency, and speed to market.

Protect confidential and proprietary information and follow Rheem policies for data access, quality, retention, and security.

Participate in cross-functional projects and perform other related duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related field

Related experience in data analysis, product data, master data, product management support, business analysis, or a related discipline preferred but open to early career skillsets

Strong attention to detail with the ability to review high-volume data, recognize inconsistencies, and follow issues through resolution.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filters, sorting, PivotTables, and data validation.

Ability to organize competing priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively with stakeholders across functions and locations.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document requirements and explain data issues in business terms.

Experience with Oracle, PIM, DAM, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Databricks, APIs, or cloud-based data platforms is a plus.

About the Organization :
The Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Modeling and Advanced Data Insights team is on a journey to modernize the way Capital One identifies potential money laundering, terrorist financing, and human trafficking through the use of advanced analytic techniques, statistics, and machine learning models. Our team develops data sourcing, predictive models, monitoring, and reporting using tools such as AWS, Snowflake, Python, and Spark. As the model development team for advancing transaction monitoring with machine learning, our team is responsible for end to end development, deployment, and monitoring of these critical risk management models.

Our mission is to empower data-driven decision-making, foster innovation without limits, and make Capital One’s AML program pre-eminent. We achieve this by implementing rigorous data governance practices, constructing analytical data stores, and harnessing the power of analytics to unlock valuable insights.
As a Manager, you will partner cross-functionally with teams throughout the enterprise including Product and Tech to deliver tangible business value. You will enhance your technical and analytical skills, while also working with leaders to influence business strategies. With a network of hundreds of Data Analysts, Quants, and Data Scientists, we drive innovation, shape strategic initiatives and propel AML Transaction monitoring to new heights. If you’re passionate about leveraging data to drive real-world impact and thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment, we want you on our team. Join us and be a catalyst for change in the world of data and analytics.

About the role
As an AI-Augmented Data Analyst , you will make an impact by transforming complex data into actionable insights that support better decision-making across underwriting, claims, finance, and operational functions. You will be a valued member of the Data & Analytics team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology partners to deliver advanced analytics solutions that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experiences.
This role combines traditional analytics expertise with emerging AI-assisted analytical techniques to accelerate insight generation while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, governance, and data quality.
In this role, you will:
+ Develop and optimize analytical solutions using Snowflake SQL and modern data analysis tools to support enterprise reporting and decision-making.
+ Perform exploratory data analysis on large structured and semi-structured datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
+ Build and maintain analytical datasets, data marts, and reporting assets that support business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives.
+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business questions into measurable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
+ Apply AI-augmented analytics techniques to improve data exploration, pattern recognition, and insight generation while ensuring results are accurate, transparent, and business-relevant.

+ Implement data quality controls, validation routines, and reconciliation processes to maintain trusted analytical assets.
+ Document business rules, data lineage, analytical methodologies, and reporting logic to support governance and knowledge sharing.
+ Partner with data engineering teams to improve data availability, integration, performance, and analytic readiness.
+ Support ad hoc analytical requests related to portfolio performance, operational effectiveness, customer behavior, and business strategy.
+ Promote responsible, ethical, and compliant use of data and AI-assisted analytics technologies.
